bio.text: Pablo José Hernández is Puerto Rico's Resident Commissioner in the U.S. House of Representatives, elected in the 2024 elections.
Born in San Juan in 1991, he is described as the youngest Resident Commissioner in the island's history.

He earned his law degree at Stanford Law School, clerked for Judge Gustavo Gelpí of the U.S. District Court for the District of Puerto Rico, and previously worked in the Office of the Governor of Puerto Rico.
